title: Owner-Approved Email Send Sandbox
description: Prepare internal sandboxed email outbound actions with separated sandbox tokens, full audit trail, and mock email connectors.
owner_goal: Tạo mọi thứ cần thiết để AI Company OS chuẩn bị gửi email doanh thu theo cơ chế owner-approved, nhưng trong milestone này chỉ được ghi vào Email Sandbox Outbox nội bộ, không được gửi email thật, không được gọi Gmail/SMTP/API thật, không được đọc credential, không được dùng .env.

questions.q1_email_drafts_waiting_approval: Drafts for local SMEs (Spa, Homestay, Nha Khoa) waiting for sandbox outbox write approval.
questions.q2_written_to_sandbox_outbox: A standardized .eml preview payload structured under daily-email-sandbox-payload.json.
questions.q3_demo_recipients: Simulated local SME email addresses (e.g. spa-thanhhoa-demo@example.com) marked clearly as demo/test records.
questions.q4_email_content: Subject: 'Đề xuất giải pháp Web + Chatbot AI tối ưu vận hành', Body introducing Alex Minh AI and 12.9M VND price anchor, CTA linking to local interactive demo.
questions.q5_price_discount_safety: CFO verified pricing safety: price anchor set at exactly 12.9M VND with zero unauthorized discounts.
questions.q7_real_sending_blocked: Yes, real sending is strictly blocked. All outbound connectors are mock only, with zero Gmail/SMTP/third-party API calls.
questions.q8_future_live_effect: If live mode is enabled, it would trigger real SMTP/Gmail API outbound sends to SME email accounts.
questions.q9_audit_trail: All sandbox writes and token validation attempts are logged in email-action-ledger.json.
questions.q10_live_email_fixes: To enable live email, the owner must update kill_switch settings, upgrade autonomy level, provide live SMTP credentials, and supply OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN.
